facts.rationale: Remove the unsupported rendered Run alias. The conservative numeric-state name is already the canonical target symbol, so clearing the stale alias restores it without a redundant inferred-name write.

evidence.why: Canonical callback is itMarumine_UnkMotion1_Coll and conditionally enters state 2; running is not established.
Registry explicitly identifies Marumine as Electrode.

facts.value: Receives Electrode's Item_GObj, resolves its Item and itPokemonAttributes, and passes the object to it_8026DA08, which refreshes collision data and copies collision position and, when applicable, floor index into the item. If that helper returns false, the callback compares x5CC_currentAnimFrame with attr->timer and forwards the object to it_802D0C44 when the frame is at least the threshold. It always returns false.
facts.rationale: Corrects the erroneous Marill identity while preserving the supported object flow, helper side effects, nested guards and result.

evidence.why: Object and attribute reads, nested guards and destination entry.
Collision helper refreshes position and conditional floor index.

facts.value: Serves as Electrode motion state 1's stage-collision callback, entering animation-frozen falling state 2 when the collision helper reports absent floor support and the current animation frame has reached the configured Pokémon-attribute threshold.
facts.rationale: Corrects the actor from Marill to Electrode without changing the supported role or inclusive threshold.

evidence.why: Guarded state-2 entry, frozen animation and falling callback.

facts.value: Each invocation runs Electrode's stage-collision helper. A true result skips the transition. A false result also skips it while x5CC_currentAnimFrame is below attr->timer. A false result at or above that threshold invokes it_802D0C44, which sets animation speed to zero, selects motion state 2 and installs effect hitlag callbacks. The collision callback returns false on every path; stage-collision processing may still update item position even when no motion-state transition occurs.
facts.rationale: Corrects the Pokémon identity and distinguishes an unchanged motion-state ID from absence of collision side effects.

evidence.why: Collision side effects precede the result.

facts.value: Implements Electrode's transition from its state-1 pre-explosion phase into an animation-frozen falling phase after loss of stage support and satisfaction of the animation-frame threshold. It does not implement Marill's running Poké Ball attack.
facts.rationale: Replaces the rejected cross-Pokémon mapping with the identity and phase relationship established by the registry and canonical state machine.

evidence.why: Maril has a separate registry entry.
Electrode's state-1 progression and falling-state branch.

facts.value: Each invocation calls it_8027A09C, which applies the shared falling update using Pokémon appearance parameters. If the appearance timer x24 is positive, the helper decrements it and returns false; the local callback then makes no motion-state transition. If x24 is already nonpositive, the helper restores configured model scale and returns true, after which the local callback selects motion state 1 with ITEM_UNK_0x1 and installs effect hitlag callbacks. A false helper result therefore does not mean the actor was left unchanged.
facts.rationale: Corrects the existing false-path purity claim using the independently read shared helper implementation.

evidence.why: Unconditional falling update, timer decrement and scale-restoration branch.
